name: producthunt-mcp
description: Product Hunt (social): me, read_comments, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_producthunt_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PRODUCTHUNT_TOKEN
platform_mcp_producthunt_token.description: Product Hunt API token: the non-expiring developer_token of your application in the API dashboard (https://www.producthunt.com/v2/oauth/applications), or an OAuth user token with scopes public private; sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' (https://api.producthunt.com/v2/docs).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Query.viewer (needs a user-context token: the developer_token or an OAuth user token; a client-only token has no viewer) returns account.data.viewer.user {id, username, name, headline, url}.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: Post.comments(first, order NEWEST) of the post with id `post_id` (numeric Product Hunt post id; Query.post also takes a slug, not mapped). Cursor-paginated: only the first `limit` comments (max 20 here) are returned and `page` is not honoured; top-level comments only (replies are Comment.replies).

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: Launch counts of one post: votesCount, commentsCount, reviewsRating and featuredAt as top-level fields (no views in the API). An unknown id answers data.post = null, reported as invalid_input.
